maintained-review.json.review: fresh independent maintained-source promotion review r1
maintained-review.json.method: Static read-only review of all ten frozen source/test pieces and surrounding callers. No source imports, runtime, tests, network, or accelerator execution. Source and patch SHA256 values verified against freeze manifest.

findings.title: Preserve dormant FP8 head metadata when applying training gradients
findings.evidence_level: static source derivation; runtime reproduction delegated to authors
findings.body: Default FP8 conversion now attaches an operation to the untied lm_head, but NativeLlamaModel.next_token_loss (llama_native.py:580-582), including the production training path, passes only its raw weight to fused CE. The operation's six arrays are unused differentiable leaves, yielding zero cotangents. TrainerState.take_train_step partitions that whole Fp8DotGeneralOp as overwrite state, and haliax.quantization.apply_updates unconditionally replaces it, so the head scales initialized to one become zero after a training update. The new unembed branch (llama_native.py:547-549) later uses those zero scales and histories: update_fp8_meta retains a zero scale for an empty history and quantization divides by zero. Finite nonzero inputs therefore produce invalid or degenerate logits. Checkpoint continuation faithfully retains the corrupted state. The new resume test checks only zero head input history at test_train_lm.py:1470, which cannot distinguish healthy dormant metadata from all-zero corruption. Preserve unused metadata at the shared overwrite boundary while leaving fused CE unchanged, and exercise post-training logits as well as restored metadata.

maintained_piece_assessment.lib/haliax/src/haliax/quantization.py: Maintained shared target-selection API; extraction preserves the previous final-name list and full-path regex semantics. No independent defect found in this refactor.
Maintained native projection integration. Output-first contraction dimensions, FSDP gather before contraction, output layout, and bias path are coherent with surrounding callers; shared custom VJP is reused.
Maintained production entrypoint. Explicit FP8-only and no-adapter guards retain declared unfinished INT8/LoRA scope; NoAdaptorConfig supplies the True trainability filter.
maintained_piece_assessment.lib/levanter/src/levanter/models/llama_n: Maintained logits/unembed path, including sharding override and tied embeddings. Fused training loss remains unchanged. New quantized untied head exposes R1-F1 after training.
maintained_piece_assessment.lib/levanter/src/levanter/quantization.p: Maintained unified conversion boundary. Named-only trees delegate directly; native conversion uses shared FP8 implementation. ArrayStacked vmap initializes per-layer metadata with full paths retained. R1-F1 blocks promotion as frozen.
maintained_piece_assessment.lib/levanter/src/levanter/trainer.py: Maintained explicit trainer guard enabling FP8 integration. Gradient/microbatch machinery reuses public base fixes and was inspected statically; no additional introduced defect established.
Maintained state creation and optimizer separation. Full-trainability guard is explicit, metadata is initialized after parameter casting and excluded from Adam moments by existing overwrite partitioning. Dormant overwrites cause R1-F1.
maintained_piece_assessment.lib/levanter/tests/test_explicit_trainer: Maintained target-path/per-layer state and remat/scan versus unrolled-gradient regression, not an archive-only trial. Distinct seeded layer metadata makes layer mixing observable.
maintained_piece_assessment.lib/levanter/tests/test_llama_native.py: Maintained independent NumPy forward/VJP oracle, storage versus compute layout checks, metadata updates, tied-head and overridden-unembed layout behavior. Tiny shapes are bounded integration coverage, not production performance evidence.
maintained_piece_assessment.lib/levanter/tests/test_train_lm.py: Maintained public entrypoint/checkpoint continuation regression across f32/BF16 compute and microbatch modes. Exact restored-state equality and actual weight changes are useful. It currently misses the dormant-head corruption in R1-F1.

limitations: This is ordinary integration onto public shared quantizer/microbatch fixes, not review or validation of a new FP8 algorithm.
No runtime, numerical, distributed, accelerator, performance, convergence, or full-suite pass is claimed by this review.
FP8 with adapters or frozen parameters and raw INT8 remain explicitly unsupported campaign work; no compatibility shim is requested.
Named target matching refactor is statically equivalent; named runtime regressions were not run here.
Checkpoint test demonstrates intended coverage in source only until the authors report its execution.
